title: Verify a matrix factorization of the cubic discriminant

source.citation: Eleonore Faber, Colin Ingalls, Simon May, and Marco Talarico, Matrix Factorizations of the discriminant of S_n, arXiv:2209.03375

translation.notes: The paper's complete 3-by-3 S1 x S2 example is entered over Q[s1,s2,s3]. Noether verifies both matrix products against the classical cubic discriminant. Constructing the factorization from Specht modules remains outside this case.
